newsitem.title: UK: Electrocomponents up on favourable outlook.
newsitem.headline: Electrocomponents up on favourable outlook.

text.p: Shares in British Electrocomponents Plc gained on Monday after the electronic and electrical group said it had a good start to the new year.
By 0845 GMT the stock was up 8-1/2p at 408-1/2p.
"The market reacted positively on the results but, more important, the outlook is very bright," one trader said.
Electrocomponents posted a pre-tax profit of 112.4 million stg, coming in at the top-end of market expectations which were in a range of 108 to 112 million stg.
The current financial year, which started in April, began with growth in all important markets and an indication of improving market conditions in mainland Europe, the company said.
